mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.2 percentage points in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises by >0.2pp in a month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader consumer demand contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or the interaction term in a regression model has a p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During periods when industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 110.0, indicating a contraction in manufacturing output, supply chain disruptions intensify, leading to higher input costs and reduced corporate margins, which drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 110.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in consumer spending (RSAFS) exceeds 3.0%, it signals strong consumer demand that boosts corporate revenues and earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS YoY change > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and rising employment growth (PAYEMS > 100k monthly), the labor market is tight, leading to higher wage pressures and inflation, which triggers a Fed tightening cycle that reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with wage pressures
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 100k, or the interaction term in a regression model has a p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past quarter signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate investment and economic growth prospects, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO has declined over the prior quarter, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 3.5% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0% annualized, it signals aggressive monetary tightening and persistent inflation, which increases the cost of capital and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 3.5% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the interaction term in a regression model has a p-value > 0.05.
